current.text: Portland's backcourt is crowded. Damian Lillard returns, Ja Morant and Jrue Holiday were added, and Deni Avdija also handles the ball.
He is projected to come off the bench. The projected starting five is Lillard, Morant, Camara, Avdija and Clingan.
Veteran guards keep blocking his path. He projects as a bench player of about 20 minutes with few chances.
He is not expected to play much and is not draftable in fantasy.
Minutes and usage in Portland's rotation are expected to swing from game to game.
He is healthy and expected to play a full season.
Portland has a new head coach this season.
In late June Portland was rumored to be in trade talks for Jaylen Brown, and Henderson was named a likely outgoing piece.
The August team preview doubts that Portland makes a consolidation trade.
Only 47.3% of his potential assists turned into assists.
The low assist conversion is likely due to poor finishing by teammates such as Donovan Clingan, Toumani Camara and Deni Avdija.

note: Both sites value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 180, ESPN rank 206), so he sits outside the 144 players our league drafts. Do not bid on him: he projects as a bench guard of about 20 minutes, and his FG% has never been above 42% on 10 or more shots. Yahoo's 0.7 TO projection looks far too low next to his 2.4 to 3.4 per game history, so use ESPN's 2.7. Keep him on the waiver radar early in the season only if a trade or an injury to Lillard, Morant or Holiday opens real guard minutes.
